notes:
- **New PC? Point A9 Voice at your notes folder and it finds the notes already there.** A new PC pointed at a folder that already holds your notes started with an empty list. **Find notes in this folder** (Settings › Notes › Storage) now offers the notes it finds, right after **Change…**, at startup over an empty list, or when you press **Find…**. It only reads the files and changes nothing until you edit a note. See [Moving your notes to a new PC](/docs/templates-and-export/#moving-your-notes-to-a-new-pc).
- **Export can now include your notes and learned voices.** **Include my notes** carries summaries, transcripts, images and the details a folder can't hold, never audio. **Include learned voices** is off unless you tick it. Import shows what is in the file with a checkbox for each part and merges notes without replacing or deleting any.
